m1-s1-a1-q01: Specific visual direction: One close-up cluster of three overlapping knowledge cards: a small simple picture on one, a line of abstract writing on one, and a sound-wave motif on one. This represents information in different forms. No labels.
m1-s1-a1-q02: Specific visual direction: One close-up friendly desktop computer actively transforming a few simple colored data tiles on its display using a small gear motif. Show a process in progress, not a labeled input-process-output diagram.
m1-s1-a1-q03: Specific visual direction: One close-up desktop computer with a small gear and neatly arranged colored digital tiles on its screen, representing the field of computing. Keep the whole computer visible, no labels.
m1-s1-a1-q04: Specific visual direction: One complete compact desktop computer workstation in close-up: monitor, tower, keyboard and mouse, with simple application window shapes on the monitor to suggest hardware plus software. No extra objects, no readable text.
m1-s1-a2-q07: CRITICAL SPECIFIC SUBJECT: close-up of two hands actively rearranging three human-name index cards into alphabetical order on a desk. The cards contain only the exact names Amal, Karim, Salma. These are illustrative source data already described by the item, not an answer or category label. NO animals, animal pictures, books or unrelated decorations. Names are the only permitted text, overriding the general no-text instruction. Focus tightly on the hands and name cards.
m1-s3-a1-q01: CRITICAL: Show ONE RAM stick alone, long green printed circuit board with black memory chips and a gold connector edge. No motherboard, CPU, graphics card, tower, or any other component.
m1-s3-a1-q02: CRITICAL: Show ONE CPU alone, square chip with a silver metal top on a small green substrate. No motherboard, RAM, tower, fan, or any other component.
m1-s3-a1-q03: CRITICAL: Show ONE motherboard alone, a large circuit board with visible CPU socket and RAM slots. No loose or surrounding components, no exploded assembly sheet.
m1-s3-a1-q04: CRITICAL: Show ONE rectangular SATA SSD alone with its two distinct edge connectors. No hard disk platter, CPU, RAM, graphics card, motherboard or any other component.
m1-s3-a1-q05: CRITICAL: Show ONE computer power supply block alone with its fan grille, mains socket and short bundle of cables. No computer case, motherboard or other components.
m1-s4-a3-q02: Show a teacher looking thoughtfully at a stack of school assessment papers containing blank grade boxes. Close-up of the papers and the teacher's hand. NO computer, software interface, spreadsheet, spreadsheet grid, calculator screen, or any visual hint showing which software is the answer.
m1-s4-a3-q03: Show a student thinking beside a small globe and a question-mark-shaped thought bubble. Do not show a browser, browser logo, address bar, or named software. The activity asks the learner to choose that tool.
m1-s4-a3-q04: Show a close-up paper poster with a simple picture and blank text bars, plus a thoughtful student's hand holding a pencil. No software interface, app icon or software name.
m1-s4-a3-q05: Show a student preparing to speak beside a plain blank classroom projection screen. No slide-editor interface, presentation software icons, or app names.
m2-s1-a2-q01: Show several blank software package cards beside a neutral computer. No Windows, Linux, Apple or Android logo; the learner must choose which software is an operating system.
m2-s1-a2-q02: Show one modern generic smartphone with an entirely blank pale blue screen, no logo, mascot or identifiable operating-system interface. Do not reveal the operating system to choose.
m2-s1-a2-q04: Show a single software disc case labeled only macOS (the entity already named in the question). No Apple logo, computer, phone, or other hardware, since choosing the associated hardware is the question.
m2-s1-a2-q05: Show a generic computer waiting during a setup with a simple unlabeled progress circle. No SSD, hard drive, installation destination, or solution annotations.
m2-s3-a1-q04: Show a student hand hesitating over three blank square icon cards. Keep all three cards unmarked: do NOT draw a folder or any identifiable answer icon. The learner must choose which icon is a folder.
m1-s4-a4-q02: CRITICAL: Depict a student handwriting a school report on PAPER with a pen. NO computer, screen, word processor, software interface or app icon, because the missing software must be answered by the learner.
m1-s4-a4-q04: CRITICAL: Depict a student thoughtfully looking at a small globe, with a simple question-mark thought bubble. NO computer, browser window, address bar, search engine UI or browser icon, because the browser is the missing answer.
m1-s4-a4-q05: CRITICAL: Depict a close-up unfinished school-festival poster on PAPER, decorated with a few bunting flags and an unmarked title box, with a student's hand and pencil. NO computer, software interface, drawing-app screen, or app icon.
